persistentElement.name: persistent red edge
persistentElement.role: Carries the active skill package state and viewer attention across the megacanvas.

transitions.semanticPurpose: Carry the skill package state from prompt wall pressure into the compact skill.md package without resetting attention.
transitions.stateChange: The persistent red edge changes role from prompt wall pressure to the activation cue for the compact skill.md package.
transitions.attentionHandoff: The outgoing red edge and incoming focal axis share the same grid intersection at the midpoint.
transitions.styleContinuity: Hard-edge 0-radius geometry, grayscale hierarchy, Open Sans, and semantic red persist through the seam.
transitions.alignmentRule: Outgoing red edge and incoming focal target remain grid-locked on a shared axis.
transitions.edgeRule: All masks, panels, and apertures remain rectangular and 0-radius.
transitions.boxPaddingRule: All masks, panels, cards, and apertures keep internalPaddingPx 0; content remains flush to bounds.
transitions.grayscaleHierarchyRule: Primary, secondary, and background roles stay distinct through outgoing, bridge, and incoming states; red only marks semantic state.
transitions.genericMotionRejected: A generic fade or slide would lose the tracked package edge and hide the conceptual state change.
transitions.surprise: The red edge from prompt wall pressure becomes the first active mark in the compact skill.md package.
transitions.outgoingState: Prompt wall pressure is settled with the red edge visible.
transitions.bridgeAction: A tile morph keeps the red edge visible while the camera reframes the megacanvas.
transitions.incomingState: The compact SKILL.md package receives the edge and becomes the dominant mechanism.
transitions.compositionShift: diagonal armature resolves into centered hero.
transitions.colorShift: Red semantic state persists; grayscale roles re-balance around the incoming focal.
transitions.cameraShift: Camera reframes during the first quarter of the incoming scene, then holds for readability.
transitions.spaceShift: compressed diagonal from prompt strips to the context wall gives way to stacked package centered on the persistent red edge.

validationFrames.target: s01 outgoing focal and persistent red edge
validationFrames.passCriterion: Outgoing hierarchy and tracked edge are visible and unclipped.
The red edge remains visible while the camera crosses the declared grid axis.
Incoming mechanism owns the first eye landing without overlap or clipping.

validationChecks.passCriterion: Before, midpoint, and after frames prove persistent-edge continuity and semantic attention handoff.
